status: declared by the pull request that closes #606 before any score of a variant was computed; a measurement, not a record. Nothing is published: no variant joins any published declaration, no day after 2025-12-31 is scored, no rule changes and the live record and pin do not move. The variants were built after seeing 2018-2025, so a pass here is not a confirmation (ruling on #567)
ruling: Eleonora, directive #606: at most 3 variants, chosen from the diagnosis of step 1 (docs/pivot/dist-roll-tier3-tier5-result.md); no hindsight regime labels (ruling on #515)
diagnosis: step 1, committed before this file: tier 3 fails in 2018-19 and 2025-26 at every lead and tier 5 fails on its calibration condition, all as under-forecast; about nine tenths of the shortfall is carried by pressure days on days that are not risk dates, where the row forecasts exactly 0 (82 of 140 pressure days at the first lead). The variants therefore put mass on those days, or recalibrate by state as #602 did

parent.from: metadata/satiation_distance_598.json, variant (a); its forecasts are not changed, only recalibrated

risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+floor.label: (a) floor
risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+floor.rule: on a day that is not a risk date the forecast is raised from 0 to the walk-forward rate of pressure days among the earlier days that were not risk dates and whose outcome was observable at the block's fit (group_calibration.walk_forward_floor); nothing is floored until those days number 60; risk dates keep the forecast
risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+floor.implementation: group_calibration.walk_forward_floor, per threshold, made non-increasing in tau (probability_calibration.monotone_curves)

risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+state_floo.label: (b) floor by state
risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+state_floo.rule: as (a), with the rate taken per as-of reserve-scarcity state (0 to 3, or unknown; each leg at its own latest public row, #586) once the state holds 60 such days and 3 pressure days, the pooled rate before
risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+state_floo.implementation: group_calibration.walk_forward_floor with the state label as the group

risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+state_plat.label: (c) state Platt
risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+state_plat.rule: Platt fitted per as-of scarcity state on the state's earlier observable pairs, the pooled Platt curve while the state holds fewer than 60 pairs or 3 events; the form that took tier 5 from no to yes in #602 (state_recalibration_589 variant a), applied to this row. Fitted on every scored day, so a day that is not a risk date takes the state's curve at the clipped zero
risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+state_plat.implementation: group_calibration.walk_forward('group') with the state label as the group, per threshold, made non-increasing in tau

conditioning_variable: the reserve-scarcity state (0 to 3, or unknown) as of the decision instant of each forecast at its own horizon (pressure_judge._scarcity_states), for the pair a rate or curve is fitted on as for the day it is applied to; group_calibration.scarcity_state_label refuses any other value. No hindsight regime label (ruling on #515)
off_risk_rule: a scored day for which announcement_dating_rescore.risk_flag(splits, values, True) is false: its pressure-day type is ordinary and the day settles no coupon, as the row's own risk-date rule reads it
cadence: the judge's: a refit every 21 scored days from 61 days of history; a block's rate or curve is fitted on the pairs whose scored day is at or before its last training label (probability_calibration.past_positions)

constants.searched: none: every constant is #380's or #589's, declared before any scoring

rows.controls_reading: the parent and the best row as scored on main (the best row is recalibrated, not refitted), re-run in this measurement so that the pairs are on one run
rows.pairs_reading: each variant is paired with the best row it recalibrates

references.controls_reading: the parents are the rows.controls; none is listed twice

reports.judge: the judge as declared under the weighted rule in force: tier 1 pooled and per lead, tiers 3 and 5, for every row beside the five risk-date passers, ngboost_laplace and the two benchmarks; each variant paired with the best row at +5 bp: the Brier difference at h = 1 to 5 and the onset recall difference, pooled and by regime and pressure-day type, 90% stationary-bootstrap intervals on shared resamples, the judge's seed
reports.calibration: predicted against realised rate of a pressure day at +5 bp, by regime and pressure-day type, pooled over h = 1 to 5
reports.gained_and_lost: the onsets a variant warns and the best row does not, and the reverse, by date

unchanged: the judge, its bar, its cut-off rule, the weighted miss rule in force, the bootstrap, every published declaration, the information set, the published scarcity indicator, the frozen shortlist of #567 and the lockbox. A measurement only: nothing is published and no day after 2025-12-31 is read (docs/decisions/lockbox.md).
